42:11.text: The Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you mates from yourselves, and for the cattle
mates. By this means He creates you
. There is nothing like Him; and He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer.

42:12.text: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He enlarges provision for whom He wills, and straitens
. Verily He is the All-Knower of everything.

42:13.text: has ordained for you the same religion
, and that which We have revealed to you
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
, and that which We ordained for Ibrâhîm
(i.e. to do what it orders you to do practically)
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
call them. Allâh chooses for Himself whom He wills, and guides unto Himself who turns to Him in repentance and in obedience.

42:14.text: And they divided not till after knowledge had come to them, through

transgression between themselves. And had it not been for a Word that went forth before from your Lord for an appointed term, the matter would have been settled between them. And verily, those who were made to inherit the Scripture
are in grave doubt concerning it
(i.e. Allâh’s true religion - Islâm or the Qur’ân)

42:15.text: (religion of Islâm alone and this Qur’ân)
(O Muhammad صلى الله عليه و سلم)
[on Islâmic Monotheism by performing all that is ordained by Allâh (good deeds), and by abstaining from all that is forbidden by Allâh (sins and evil deeds)]
, as you are commanded, and follow not their desires but say: "I believe in whatsoever Allâh has sent down of the Book
[all the holy Books, - this Qur’ân and the Books of the old from the Taurât (Torah), or the Injeel (Gospel) or the Pages of Ibrâhîm (Abraham)]
and I am commanded to do justice among you. Allâh is our Lord and your Lord. For us our deeds and for you your deeds. There is no dispute between us and you. Allâh will assemble us
, and to Him is the final return."
